note: StatusEffectInstance.getEffectType() changed its return type from StatusEffect to RegistryEntry<StatusEffect> in 1.21.1, so a legacy call site compiled against the old descriptor fails with NoSuchMethodError. The bridge calls the new method and unwraps comp_349().

methodRedirects.evidence: AppleSkin FoodHelper.isRotten compared the effect to StatusEffects.HUNGER; opening the inventory crashed with NoSuchMethodError 'class_1293.method_5579()' (runs/p101-appleskin-hover/).

LivingEntity.hasStatusEffect now takes RegistryEntry<StatusEffect>, so the estimated-health path threw NoSuchMethodError 'class_1657.method_6059(class_1291)' (runs/p101-appleskin-hover/). The bridge compares the unwrapped effect values.

fieldRedirects.evidence: StatusEffects.HUNGER became a RegistryEntry constant, so AppleSkin's estimated-health path threw NoSuchFieldError 'class_1294.field_5899' (runs/p101-appleskin-hover/). The bridge resolves 'minecraft:hunger' from Registries.STATUS_EFFECT.
The same estimated-health method also reads StatusEffects.POISON (field_5920), which is a RegistryEntry on 1.21.1 (runs/p101-appleskin-hover/).
The same method reads StatusEffects.WITHER (field_5924), also a RegistryEntry on 1.21.1 (runs/p101-appleskin-hover/).
